verdict.rationale: Docs explicitly cover headless command-line cooking, packaging and deployment (UnrealEditor.exe -run=cook -targetplatform), the Unreal Automation Tool (UAT) for automating builds and tests, and general command-line arguments for running the engine without an interactive editor — together these describe a full headless build/export/CI pipeline. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on confirmation that a full CI pipeline (e.g., GitHub Actions) works reliably end-to-end, and no discussion of licensing/account gating that could complicate automated CI runs.
